contractPurpose: Non-destructive convergence of existing runtime capabilities into explicit domain authorities.

auth_session.authority: Supabase Auth + existing guarded client path

ai.authority: provider gateway / Edge architecture as matured

conflictGuards: Do not introduce a second auth/session authority.
Do not introduce a second Stripe/payment authority.
Do not introduce a second WebGL renderer/context.
Do not introduce client-authoritative financial/progression state.
Do not expose AI provider secrets to browser code.
Do not add a competing navigation registry.
Do not create a new database table when an existing canonical domain table can safely own the data.
